d: Hall in the palace of Damascus for the meetings of the council. Throne, and seats for the Satraps of the kingdom. Idrenus on the throne with followers of Satrapi and Guards, Armida and Rinaldo.
Uphill mountain, on the peaks of which I discovered the castle of Armida. Ubaldo with a continuation of Soldati.
Garden in the palace of Armida. Idreno and Zelmira.
Camping for Europeans, Ubaldo and Rinaldo.
Horrid forest, in the middle of which I saw a thick myrtle tree. Rinaldo alone.
